notice: Derived from the synthetic bench renders (abstract art, fictional names, printed grader names, no logos) and one HTML receipt. Cert numbers are test values. Never load live grader pages from tests.

metrics.classes: auto-ok / auto-WRONG (opened anything else, or any auto-open on mustNotAutoOpen) / opened-ok / opened-wrong (BGS: number shown as read, no tab) / confirm-ok (one number, right) / confirm-choose (>= 2 numbers offered, the preselected one right) / confirm-wrong (preselected number wrong) / none-ok / none-miss / fp (a number shown on a fixture with no number) / error.
metrics.topCorrect: Positives = fixtures with expected.number or numbers. Top correct = auto-ok + opened-ok + confirm-ok + confirm-choose.
metrics.hadToChoose: confirm-choose (the four two-slab photos are expected here).

fixtures.note: top 25% of the label cut off (brand/grade line kept, cert line kept)
left 28% cut: CGC brand + grade box gone, cert number kept
label touches the top edge of the photo
right 22% cut: subgrades gone, serial kept
the cert line is cut away: any number shown is wrong
two slabs psa-c01 + psa-c03: must not auto-open; the shown number must be one of the two
two slabs cgcc-c09 + cgcd-c14: must not auto-open; the shown number must be one of the two
two slabs bgs-c22 + psa-c06: must not auto-open; the shown number must be one of the two
two slabs psa-c02 + cgcc-c10: must not auto-open; the shown number must be one of the two
black label on a dark cloth
plain 10-digit number, no grader words: may show it, never open
order confirmation with 8/10/13-digit numbers that are not certs
